product_overview: Orderlly Admin App is a Flutter-based restaurant management app for owners and managers to monitor operations and manage core admin settings from mobile. The available frontend scope in the codebase is the admin dashboard, where users can review stats and move between admin sections.
core_goals: Navigate to admin sections from the dashboard

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Provides an authenticated overview of restaurant admin activity and allows navigation to related admin sections.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/dashboard -> View dashboard statistics -> Navigate to admin sections
